scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/dev.html', 'index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/dev.html', 'dist/index.html'); fs.readdirSync('dist').forEach(f => { if(f !== 'dev.html' && f !== 'index.html' && !fs.statSync('dist/' + f).isDirectory()) fs.copyFileSync('dist/' + f, f); });"
